status: PROPOSAL — staged. Erik: 'we probably need to tweak who fights and how.' The mechanism is built; the CONTENT dial inside it is flat.
staleness_note: ⚠️ FIRST: the sim table quoted (60 legendary / 5 epic / 1 regional) is PRE-RE-TIER. The roster is now 11 legendary / 27 epic / 28 heroic, live and CI-green. CCode's 'the valley has no heroes' finding is fixed — so the death-rate table wants re-running before anyone tunes against it. The 66.7% regional rate was a sample of ONE figure; there are now 28 in that band.

theGap.what: `engageRate` is a FLAT 0.35 for every figure in the world, and the only tiebreak is urgency.
theGap.why_it_matters: So THE WAR-ENDER and THE ENDER WHO FORGOT seek confrontation at exactly the same rate. A stillhold peacemaker whose want is 'to prove that any war has a door out' is as likely to pick a fight as a marcher whose want is 'to end — the why fell away years ago'. The engaged/worker split is the right mechanism and it is currently blind to who these people ARE.
theGap.and_it_is_derivable: Every figure carries `tradition`, `alignment`, `role` and a `wants` line. Disposition falls straight out of them, exactly as arc-cares did.

proposal_engagementDisposition.field: `engages` on each figure — a multiplier on the global engageRate, default 1.0

bands.seeks_it (1.8): confrontation IS their method — the fight is how they pursue the want
bands.accepts_it (1.2): will fight when the want demands, without relish
bands.avoids_it (0.5): fights only when cornered; the want is pursued another way
bands.refuses_it (0.15): ⚠️ NEVER seeks a confrontation. Their whole craft is that they do not.

proposal_engagementDisposition.stillholdIsTheProof: ⚠️ 0.15 — the lowest in the world, and it is not a nerf, it is the tradition. Its crafts say so: `step_between` puts your UNARMORED body between harm and someone else; `the_laid_ground` makes violence HARDER rather than impossible; `the_held_breath` holds maximum threat and maximum restraint in the same instant. A Stillhold figure who sought duels would contradict every bound I authored for them. AND THE MECHANIC REWARDS THEM CORRECTLY: they push as WORKERS — steady, modest, safe — which is exactly what 'the war ender' does. He does not win the arc by fighting; he wins it by still being there.

overrides_perFigure.note: ⚠️ THE HOLLOW KING AT 0.2 IS THE BEST ONE: his want is 'TO BE ASKED. He never takes; he is given.' A figure who never initiates is a figure who never seeks a confrontation — and he is a legendary-weight abyssal, so a flat rate had him duelling constantly, which contradicts the single most important line about him. The_nine_year_master at 1.9 is the inverse: her entire want is 'ONE FIGHT SHE ISN'T SURE SHE'LL WIN.' She should be seeking, always.

predictedEffects: FEWER DUELS OVERALL, and the ones that happen are between figures who should be fighting. The bloodbath CCode was correcting for gets solved by CHARACTER rather than by lowering a global rate.

⚠️ PACIFIST TRADITIONS BECOME MECHANICALLY DISTINCT INSTEAD OF JUST FLAVOURED. Stillhold, numinous and veilwright push as workers — steady and safe — so they hold arcs by ENDURANCE. That is the first time the peace/violence axis has meant anything at world scale.
GANGING-UP GETS MORE COMMON WHERE IT SHOULD BE. High-engagement traditions cluster into the engaged pool, so marchers and abyssals meet each other — and weight-matched pairing then does its job.
AND THE DEATH TABLE SHOULD SPREAD BY TRADITION, not just by tier. A world where marchers die and numinous don't is a legible world.
openQuestions: CCODE: is `engages` best as a multiplier on the global rate (my proposal, one clamp, degrades to today's behaviour if absent) or as an absolute per-figure rate? The multiplier keeps your dial meaningful.

ERIK: 0.15 for stillhold means they almost never fight. Correct for the tradition — but it also means a stillhold figure is nearly immune to dying in an arc contest. Is that right? MY READ: yes, and it should show up as them dying to something ELSE (a player, a manifestation, a betrayal) rather than in a duel they never sought.
Should high-engagement figures take MORE injury as the cost of seeking? Currently severity is tier-gap only. Seeking a fight you did not have to have could plausibly carry its own risk.
